DINGTALK_AGENT_ID.description: DingTalk application AgentId used for work notifications.

TARGET_PROCESS_CODE.description: DingTalk approval process code to auto-approve.

TARGET_SYSTEM_SOURCE.description: Form field value used to identify eligible approval requests.

ACTIONER_USER_ID.description: UserId that must be the current approval task handler.

NOTIFY_USER_ID.description: UserId that receives success and failure notifications.

ALERT_CHANNEL.description: Comma-separated alert channels, for example dingtalk,qclaw.

ALERT_THRESHOLD_MIN.description: Minutes before backup monitor treats a RUNNING approval as stuck.

BACKUP_AUTO_APPROVE.description: Whether the backup monitor should auto-approve eligible stuck requests.

BACKUP_LOOKBACK_HOURS.description: How many hours of created approval instances the backup monitor scans. Uses instance create time.

HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL.description: Seconds between heartbeat writes from approval_bot.py.

HEARTBEAT_MAX_AGE.description: Maximum heartbeat age before monitor.sh restarts the service.

WATCHDOG_ALERT_INTERVAL.description: Minimum seconds between repeated watchdog failure alerts.
